name: rx580
description: AMD Radeon RX 580 (Polaris 20 XTX, GCN 4, gfx803) at its 1340 MHz boost clock: one Vortex core per compute unit (CU).

sources.NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH, NUM_WARPS: 4 SIMD16 units per CU running wave64 over 4 clocks, so 64 FP32 lanes per CU; 10 waves per SIMD, 40 per CU (AMD GCN architecture whitepaper)
sources.FETCH_WIDTH: One instruction arbiter per CU: it issues to one SIMD per clock in turn, and each SIMD's wave64 instruction occupies it for 4 clocks, so one fetch slice feeds the four blocks
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES: 16 VALU lanes per SIMD, shared by FP32 and integer instructions on the part; Vortex has separate ALU and FPU blocks, each given the 16 lanes
sources.NUM_LSU_LANES, NUM_LSU_BLOCKS: 16 load/store units per CU in one vector-memory pipeline (576 on Polaris 10) behind the 64 B per clock L1
sources.DCACHE_SIZE: 16 KB L1 vector cache per CU, 64 B lines
sources.ICACHE_SIZE: 32 KB instruction cache shared by up to 4 CUs, i.e. 8 KB per CU
sources.LMEM_LOG_SIZE, LMEM_NUM_BANKS: 64 KB LDS per CU, 32 banks of 4 B = 128 B per clock; Vortex banks are XLEN wide (8 B), so 16 banks carry the same bytes per clock
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 2 MB L2 in 8 channels of 256 KB, one per 32-bit memory controller, 16-way
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 256-bit GDDR5 at 8 Gbps modelled as 16 GDDR6 x16 channels at 8000 MT/s: 16 x 2 B x 8 GT/s = 256 GB/s, the card's bandwidth; latency not calibrated
sources.EXT_MUFU_ENABLE, NUM_MUFU_LANES: Transcendentals at a quarter of the VALU rate: 4 per SIMD, 16 per CU per clock
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE: Off: GCN 4 has no matrix units
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: GPUVM paging, global and LDS atomics with compare-swap, FP16 instructions, workgroup barriers, and the graphics pipeline (4 texture units per CU, rasterizers, ROPs) of a gaming part
sources.xlen: 64-bit machine: 64-bit pointers and FP64. FP64 runs at 1/16 of FP32 (4 per CU per clock) on the part; with XLEN=64 every FPU lane executes FP64, so the profile has 64 FP64 lanes per CU
sources.SIMD_WIDTH: 16: each SIMD's VGPR file feeds 16 lanes per clock and a wave64 instruction occupies its SIMD for 4 clocks, so the slice datapath is 16 lanes and a warp moves as 4 packets (the default, NUM_THREADS, would make the register file and dispatch path 4x wider than the part and issue a wave instruction every clock)
sources.FDIV_PE_RATIO, FSQRT_PE_RATIO: Transcendentals (reciprocal, reciprocal square root, on which division and square root are built) run at a quarter of the FP32 rate on GCN, RDNA and CDNA: FPU lanes / 4
sources.DCACHE_NUM_BANKS: 64 B per clock of vector L1 per CU (GCN / CDNA 2): 2 banks of the 32 B dcache word; the default gives 4
